design_condition: The quiet building is placed within the orthogonal pool complex, with an almost symmetrical entrance facing the canal and a long terrace extending toward the outdoor pool.

positive.statement: The project develops a clear concept with high qualities in terms of floor plans and external appearance.
The centrally arranged access area is clear, spacious, and convincingly designed as a control point.
The restaurant with its full-length terrace and view of the outdoor pool is very attractive.
The external expression is very appealing, with a fine and systematic facade structure.
The project authors succeeded in developing a clear concept valued as an outstanding contribution.

negative.statement: The catering area is not optimally organized for full operation.
The strong spatial separation between the swimming pool and the arcade is criticized.
The main passage and the parallel passage past hairdryers and showers do not work operationally or for bathers.
The superficially clear division of the room program becomes complicated and inflexible in detail.
There are not enough toilets on the hall floor, and the route to swimming equipment is too long.
The basement storage and disposal rooms are very inconvenient, while the delivery route is too prominent and too narrow.
The workshop inside the building is unusable because it has no daylight.
The treatment of topography in the access area with parking facilities is considered unmanaged.
The interior is too bulky and lacks the subtlety and spatial character sought for by a bather.
Expected investment and operating costs are in the upper third because of the relatively large volume and above-average maintenance costs.
